correctness.rationale: Prime-factorial valuations of 2!,3!,5!,7!,11!,13! form a unimodular lattice basis. Inspecting the actual eight atomic generators and exact equations a1=c1+2t−3r, a2=c2+t, a3=c3+r, a4=c4−t, a5=c5, a6=c6−t reconstructs every fiber. Orient the two valid elementary relations toward r decreasing and then a4+a6 decreasing; the well-founded lex measure forces termination. An irreducible has r*a3=0 and a4*a6=0, hence unique r=max(0,−c3) and t=min(c4,c6), proving connectivity of all factorizations and a toric complete intersection of height two. Exact feasible integer ranges give the atomic count, contiguous step-two lengths and delta {2}; the length-two versus length-four element 14!*5! proves catenary degree ≥4, while each move gives ≤4. Independently enumerated every fiber of 3923 distinct products up to 10^16, 3975 total atomic representations, checked exactly the two identities, fiber relation connectivity and closed length interval for each. Finite bound corroborates symbolic proof, not infinity.
